chapters.title: The Copy
chapters.purpose: Pema and Cal carry the duplicate page and an older pencil copy outdoors to the same archive site to compare them in daylight, checking paper, ink and the line that records the tide reading.
chapters.turn: Comparing the two documents on site, Cal identifies a transposed line; they agree on a corrected reading and a label, while Pema notes what daylight confirms and what it cannot. The chapter stops with the wax packet still sealed and the corrected comparison set aside for the demonstration.
hookSeeds: Does the outdoor comparison hold up under scrutiny at the demonstration?
